findings.title: Live fast-path PIPE_DRAWN append ships unpinned — a revert passes every CI gate
findings.evidence: exec.odin: `if inp.sim_events != nil { append(inp.sim_events, pp.Event{tick = inp.tick + 1, tag = pp.EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN}) }`; harness/parity.odin:202 `// NOTE: sim_events stays NIL here on purpose`; main.odin:367 `pp.step(&app.state, app.tick, {}, &cat)`; zero *_test.odin files reference commit_draw or sim_events (grep-verified).
findings.detail: The shipped game's wire click — one of this PR's two features — depends solely on this append. Parity nils sim_events; goldens drive step's batch path; no unit test drives commit_draw. Deleting the append or the main.odin wiring is CI-silent. This repo's own r5/r6 'wiring shipped unpinned' blocker class.
findings.recommended_fix: Exec-level test (settings_effect_wiring precedent): Input with wired sim_events + log scratch, drive commit_draw, assert exactly one Event{tick = inp.tick+1, tag = EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN} on a valid draw and none on an invalid one.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: FAIL (P0 0% — live wire-click path; overall ~70%)
findings.evidence: P0 = the live wire-placed click path (zero coverage, see blocker 1); P1 ~75% (step/spawn emissions integration-pinned via T1 + vacuous guards, consumer unit-FULL, immediacy AC unverified); overall ~70%.
findings.detail: Gate rubric: FAIL when P0 <100%. Same root cause as blocker 1 plus the missing core negative legs (warning 6).
findings.recommended_fix: Land the exec-level commit_draw pin (P0 to 100%) and the core emission unit tests incl. negative legs (P1 >=90%); re-run the gate.

findings.title: "ALL FOUR kinds" claim for audio.dem is false — spawn coverage lives only in audio_spawn.dem
findings.evidence: run.odin comment headlines `audio.dem: ALL FOUR kinds (crisis + arrival + the v2-sound wire + spawn …` then self-corrects (`…the spawn coverage lives in audio_spawn.dem instead`); audio.dem has no `growth on` (grep-verified) so NODE_SPAWNED cannot fire; the name=="audio" guard asserts crisis_draws/arrival_draws/wire_draws only.
findings.detail: The guard code is right; the comments/PR body overstate. A maintainer trusting the headline could drop audio_spawn.dem believing audio.dem covers spawn — misleading under the W3/W4 vacuous-guard doctrine.
findings.recommended_fix: Reword all three spots: audio.dem proves crisis+arrival+wire; audio_spawn.dem proves spawn+wire. Drop the 'ALL FOUR kinds' phrase and the dangling 'add growth on…' fragment.

findings.title: Spawn placeholder is 0.66 s of sequential tones — not 'layered over ~0.3 s', outside the README's 0.2–0.4 s slot envelope
findings.evidence: tone_append is append-only (audio.odin:448-456 — appends dur_s*RATE samples, no offset/mix); .Spawn appends 0.22 + 0.30 + 0.14 = 0.66 s; comment says 'layered over ~0.3 s with a gentle tail'; README says 'Spawn chimes: 0.2–0.4 s'.
findings.detail: The asset-less default every player hears is a 0.66 s arpeggio — 65% past the slot contract this same diff ships for real assets; the comment describes a different waveform than the code produces.
findings.recommended_fix: Mix the three layers into one ~0.3 s buffer (offset writes), or shorten durations to land in 0.2–0.4 s; align comment + README with the actual waveform.

findings.title: SPAWN_TICK is an octave above its documented labels ('a fifth above the body' / README D5-E5-C5)
findings.evidence: SPAWN_TICK :: [3]f32{1175, 1320, 1046} = D6/E6/C6; SPAWN_BODY {392,440,349} = G4/A4/F4; a fifth above = 587/659/523 (D5/E5/C5) — the README's labels. Code comment: 'high tick (a fifth above the body)'.
findings.detail: The placeholder and the asset contract disagree by an octave: a Suno file built to the README's D5 spec replaces a D6 placeholder — the dropped-in sound lands an octave lower than the default.
findings.recommended_fix: Either halve SPAWN_TICK to {587, 659, 523} to match the documented recipe, or correct the comment + README to D6/E6/C6.

findings.title: toggle_mute stops only crisis+arrival — the new wire/spawn sounds ring past a mid-sound mute flip
findings.evidence: toggle_mute's muted branch: `for s in a.crisis { rl.StopSound(s) }` / `for s in a.arrival { rl.StopSound(s) }` — no wire/spawn loops (diff added the families + PlaySound paths but not the stop path). audio_flush:281 gates NEW plays on mute, so only already-playing sounds leak.
findings.detail: The spawn chime (0.66 s placeholder) keeps ringing after a mute flip — the doc comment above toggle_mute says the stop 'keeps the flip immediate'.
findings.recommended_fix: In toggle_mute's muted branch add `for s in a.wire { rl.StopSound(s) }` and `for s in a.spawn { rl.StopSound(s) }`.

findings.title: Fast-path event append falls outside the app's per-tick hash window — app stats stream no longer replay-identical at draw ticks
findings.evidence: App: events_before marked at step start; PIPE_DRAWN appended at handle_input time (same frame, after the step loop) — excluded from every per-tick events[before:] slice. Harness/replay: the same event is emitted inside step's command loop at the apply tick — included in that tick's slice. main.odin comment claims 'the app stream is replay-identical for the same seed + commands'.
findings.detail: At wire-draw ticks the app's --stats-out sim_hash now differs from the harness/replay hash (events enter state_hash). Diagnostics-only — no CI gate compares the app stream — but the shipped claim is falsified by this diff.
findings.recommended_fix: Defer the fast-path append to the apply tick's step boundary (inside the hashed window), or amend the 'SAME slice'/'replay-identical' comments to document the exclusion at draw ticks.

findings.title: New core emissions pinned only via T1 hashes — no core unit tests name tags 15/16; negative legs unpinned
findings.evidence: grep core/*_test.odin: zero references to EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN / EVENT_TAG_NODE_SPAWNED (while 10 test files pin prior tags); project-context.md:75: 'Pin every design invariant as a regression test at the lowest layer (core/)… Acceptance criteria become durable tests, not PR prose.'
findings.detail: T1 hashes bite on any change but localize nothing; the negative legs (no PIPE_DRAWN on a rejected command, no NODE_SPAWNED with growth off) have no named assertions.
findings.recommended_fix: Core tests: successful Cmd_Draw_Pipe at apply tick emits exactly one PIPE_DRAWN; a failing command emits none; growth tick with intent.spawn emits NODE_SPAWNED, growth-off emits none.

findings.title: audio_spawn golden docs cite a 'draw at 100 ms' but the demo's draws are at 2000/2500 ms
findings.evidence: audio_spawn.dem header: 'the recipe's draw at 100 ms also fires EVENT_TAG_PIPE_DRAWN'; run.odin guard message: '(recipe draws at 100 ms)'; actual commands: `at 2000ms draw 1 3 standard` / `at 2500ms draw 0 1 standard` (the 1000 ms entry is a router place).
findings.detail: Stale copy from audio.dem (whose draws ARE at 100 ms). The guard works — the rationale text just cites the wrong ticks.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the header + guard message to 2000/2500 ms.

findings.title: load_variant doc comment duplicated — orphaned copy sits above the Sound_Kind enum
findings.evidence: Lines 331-333 carry the full load_variant doc comment directly above `Sound_Kind :: enum`; lines 355-357 carry the identical comment above the real proc.
findings.detail: The enum now wears a proc's doc comment; the copy-paste seam from the refactor.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete the first copy so Sound_Kind carries only its own comment.

findings.title: kind_volume's trailing return is unreachable and masks a future non-exhaustive switch
findings.evidence: Exhaustive 4-case switch over Sound_Kind followed by `return ARRIVAL_VOLUME` — unreachable today; a future fifth member silently falls back instead of failing the build.
findings.recommended_fix: Remove the trailing return so a new Sound_Kind member breaks compilation.

findings.title: Immediacy acceptance criterion (~50 ms) has no automated verification — by-construction argument only
findings.location: app/main.odin (audio_mark drain site); briefing acceptance line
findings.evidence: Briefing: 'Latency/immediacy verified (sound within ~50 ms of event)'. PR body argues by construction (drain once per frame = <=1 frame ~=16.7 ms). No test pins the step -> drain -> flush ordering.
findings.detail: The AC ships as PR prose; the ordering that guarantees it is unpinned app wiring (same class as the exec gap, lower stakes).
findings.recommended_fix: Pin the drain ordering as a seam test, or record the criterion as by-construction-reviewed with reviewer sign-off.

findings.title: Wire/spawn flush loops join the untested device-gated surface; the cited 'app smoke check' exists nowhere in CI
findings.evidence: audio_test.odin header: 'the flush/play half is device-gated and covered by the app smoke check + manual verification' — the 10 CI gates contain no app smoke check (pre-existing 7.2 text). Vacuous guards count consume-side draws only, so deleting the new PlaySound loops ships green.
findings.detail: Consistent with the 7.2 convention for crisis/arrival, but each new family widens the untested surface and the header cites a check that doesn't exist.
findings.recommended_fix: Extract the pure variant-cycling computation from audio_flush and unit-test it; add the smoke check to CI or drop the claim.
